node: Dry-type transformers, power-quality products, and specialty magnetics
summary: Layer 1B expanded the direct public-company universe for dry-type transformers, power-quality products, and specialty magnetics. The strongest direct pure-play candidate is Hammond Power Solutions via its Canadian primary listing and U.S. OTC line; the most relevant U.S.-listed underfollowed component candidate is Bel Fuse through transformers, chokes, inductors, power supplies, and custom magnetic solutions. Powell Industries is included as an adjacent direct power-distribution/switchgear reference because switchgear shortages sit beside transformer shortages in the same project-critical electrical chain. Hubbell is included as a larger reference name with explicit data-center power-quality, active harmonic filter, PDU transformer, and modular switchboard exposure, but it is less pure.
